Answer: E
Reason: The coronal CT image (Figure 1) demonstrates a distinct, rounded hyperdense lesion located in the lateral aspect of the right mid-lung zone, which corresponds anatomically to the right middle lobe. This position is lateral rather than medial (ruling out B) and lower than the upper lobe (ruling out A), making option E the most accurate description of the pseudoaneurysm's location among the choices provided.
